conceptual_change: Shift from high-variance wide liquidity sweep strategies to a fundamental baseline liquidity-mean-reversion model to establish a verifiable performance anchor.
rationale: The failure analysis for BC 32 indicates that validation evidence is missing for the complex sweep_wide_effort strategy. Reverting to the baseline allows for the creation of a control group evaluation in the In-Sample/Validation split, ensuring that subsequent complex hypotheses have a baseline metric for comparative performance.
